nodes.description: Private bool flag in MultiplierToken indicating whether the gambling game has been started; only set true once in startGame and never reset.
Address of the ETH-X20 Uniswap liquidity pool; transfers originating from this address are the only ones eligible to win the 10x reward.
Private uint nonce that is incremented on every _randModulus call and mixed into the keccak256 randomness seed.
Private uint seed supplied by the owner in startGame and used as the winning-play random seed.
Private uint seed derived from _randModulus in startGame and used for the burn-rate randomness.
Private uint chanceRate hard-coded to 100 in startGame; effectively unused by the actual win logic.
Ownable._owner address; the privileged account allowed through the onlyOwner modifier.
ERC20 mapping of account balances, mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ERC20 total supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
MultiplierToken constructor: mints 10000e18 tokens to msg.sender and sets gameStarted to false.
onlyOwner function that initialises the game: sets chanceRate, liquidityPool, seed1, derives seed2 and flips gameStarted to true. Cannot be re-run.
Overridden ERC20 transfer that reroutes the amount through _getAmount so burn/reward logic runs before super.transfer.
Overridden ERC20 transferFrom that reroutes the amount through _getAmount (with sender as the origin address) before super.transferFrom.
Public view returning the gameStarted state variable.
Private hook computing the effective transfer amount: when the game started it pays rewards via _sendReward and burns a random portion of the amount.
Private reward routine: when the sender is the liquidity pool and _play() returns true, mints 10x the amount to the recipient.
Private function returning the random deflationary burn amount, between 1% and 10% of the transfer amount.
Public (state-changing) game function comparing two _randModulus(100, seed) values; returns true with ~1% probability.
Private pseudo-random generator mixing nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty and msg.sender through keccak256 and taking modulo mod; also increments nonce.
Inherited ERC20 internal mint that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account].
Inherited ERC20 internal burn that decreases _balances[account] and _totalSupply.
Inherited ERC20 internal transfer that debits sender and credits recipient balances.
Ownable modifier enforcing that _owner == _msgSender() before the modified function body executes.
Context helper returning msg.sender as address payable.
External caller identity (msg.sender), attacker controllable; used as transfer origin, owner check and randomness input.
block.timestamp (now) used as a randomness seed component in _randModulus; miner manipulable.
_mint(recipient, amount.mul(10)) inside _sendReward: arbitrary 10x token creation executed before the sender balance is debited.
_burn(sender, burnAmount) inside _getAmount: deflationary burn charged to the sender on every qualifying transfer.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty, msg.sender)) % mod: weak on-chain pseudo-randomness.
amount.mul(10) used to size the reward mint; multiplies circulating supply by ten for a winning liquidity-pool transfer.
amount.div(burnrate.add(10)) division used to derive the burn amount; divisor is derived from an attacker-influenced random value.
Parameter _liquidityPool of startGame: address stored as the winning liquidity pool.
Parameter _seed1 of startGame: owner supplied randomness seed written to state_seed1.
Parameter recipient of transfer: destination address of the token transfer.
Parameter amount of transfer: amount passed into _getAmount.
Parameter sender of transferFrom: source address debited by the transfer.
Parameter recipient of transferFrom: destination address of the transfer.
Parameter amount of transferFrom: amount passed into _getAmount.
Parameter recipient of _getAmount: forwarded to _sendReward as the reward mint target.
Parameter sender of _getAmount: compared with liquidityPool and charged the burn.
Parameter amount of _getAmount: value mutated by subtracting the random burn amount.
Parameter amount of _sendReward: base value multiplied by ten for the mint.
Parameter sender of _sendReward: equality checked against liquidityPool.
Parameter recipient of _sendReward: address credited with the 10x mint.
Parameter amount of _getRandomBurnedAmount: dividend of the burn-rate division.
Parameter mod of _randModulus: modulus applied to the keccak256 hash.
Parameter seed of _randModulus: secondary randomness input chosen by the caller/owner.
Local variable burnAmount in _getAmount holding the computed deflationary burn.
Local variable burnrate in _getRandomBurnedAmount holding _randModulus(90, seed2).
Local variable val1 in _play holding _randModulus(100, seed1).
Local variable val2 in _play holding _randModulus(100, seed2); compared against val1.
Local variable rand in _randModulus holding the keccak256 hash modulo mod.

edges.reason: startGame writes the gameStarted flag to true, enabling the gambling logic.
startGame stores the owner supplied liquidity pool address in state.
startGame writes the owner supplied _seed1 into seed1.
startGame writes the derived random value into seed2.
startGame sets chanceRate to the constant 100.
startGame calls _randModulus to derive seed2.
The onlyOwner modifier gates startGame so only the owner can start the game.
msg.sender is compared with _owner inside the onlyOwner check.
msg.sender is hashed into the pseudo-random value produced by _randModulus.
block.timestamp is used as a randomness seed component, creating timestamp dependency on the game outcome.
The nonce state variable is read and incremented by _randModulus.
seed1 is hashed inside _randModulus when called from _play.
seed2 is hashed inside _randModulus for burn-rate and play randomness.
_play reads seed1 to generate val1.
_play reads seed2 to generate val2.
_play invokes _randModulus twice to obtain val1 and val2.
_getRandomBurnedAmount invokes _randModulus to obtain the burn rate.
_sendReward calls the public _play function to decide whether the reward is paid.
_sendReward compares the sender against the stored liquidityPool address.
Winning plays trigger the reward mint unsafe operation for the recipient.
amount.mul(10) defines the minted reward size, arbitrarily expanding total supply.
_getAmount calls _sendReward on every qualifying transfer while the game is running.
_getAmount calls _getRandomBurnedAmount to compute the deflationary burn.
_getAmount branches on the gameStarted state variable.
_getAmount performs the burn unsafe operation when burnAmount is non-zero.
_getRandomBurnedAmount calls _randModulus(90, seed2).
_getRandomBurnedAmount divides the amount by the burn rate plus ten.
The burn rate local variable is assigned the random modulus result.
The burn division consumes the randomly generated burn rate divisor.
transfer routes the amount through _getAmount before executing the underlying transfer.
transferFrom routes the amount through _getAmount before executing the underlying transferFrom.
transfer uses msg.sender as the sender passed into the reward/burn logic.
transferFrom uses msg.sender only for the allowance spender check.
transfer relies on _msgSender to obtain the caller address.
transfer calls super.transfer which executes the internal _transfer balance update.
transferFrom calls super.transferFrom which executes the internal _transfer balance update.
_transfer debits and credits the _balances mapping.
_mint credits the recipient balance in the _balances mapping.
_mint increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_burn debits the account balance in the _balances mapping.
_burn decreases _totalSupply by the burned amount.
_play assigns the seed1 random result to val1.
_play assigns the seed2 random result to val2.
_randModulus builds its result from the keccak256 weak-randomness unsafe operation.
The keccak256 hash modulo mod is assigned to the local rand variable.
The constructor mints the initial 10000e18 supply to the deployer.
The constructor initialises gameStarted to false.
The 10x reward is minted to the recipient before _transfer debits the sender balance, so state is updated in an inconsistent order that can be re-entered through the public _play/_getAmount path.
hasGameStarted returns the gameStarted state variable.
startGame parameter _liquidityPool is validated and written into liquidityPool state.
startGame parameter _seed1 is written into seed1 state.
transfer parameter recipient is forwarded to _getAmount and super.transfer.
transfer parameter amount is transformed by _getAmount.
transferFrom parameter sender is passed as the burn/reward origin address.
transferFrom parameter recipient is forwarded to _getAmount and super.transferFrom.
transferFrom parameter amount is transformed by _getAmount.
_getAmount parameter recipient feeds the reward mint target.
_getAmount parameter sender feeds the liquidity pool comparison and burn.
_getAmount parameter amount is reduced by the burned amount and returned.
_sendReward parameter amount is multiplied by ten for the mint.
_sendReward parameter sender is compared with liquidityPool.
_sendReward parameter recipient receives the minted reward.
_getRandomBurnedAmount parameter amount is divided by the burn rate.
_randModulus parameter mod bounds the resulting random value.
_randModulus parameter seed is packed into the keccak256 input.
Local burnAmount is used by _getAmount to reduce the transferred amount.
Local rand is the value returned by _randModulus and incremented nonce side effect.
